locality: village near the old tank, Tamil Nadu
hydrology: one seasonal tank fed by the northeast monsoon; two working wells; tank dry March to September
ecology: palmyra and tamarind stands around the tank bund; migratory birds in the wet season
seasonality: sowing after the first monsoon fill; festival at first overflow
sensitivities: exact well locations are not shown publicly
correctionRoute: corrections go to the panchayat water committee reviewer
withdrawalRoute: the committee can withdraw the pack or any asset; distribution stops on the next sync
